title: AORT I1 - normalized telemetry observation (PROVISIONAL, NOT FROZEN)
description: One normalized observation of one signal of one banking-system component, produced by telemetry/normalizer from real Prometheus data. Proposed by Owner B for joint review with Owner A as the Layer 1 -> Layer 2 (digital twin) interface. Must not be treated as frozen until both owners agree.

snapshot_id.description: UUID4 shared by every observation taken at the same evaluation instant.

observed_at.description: Prometheus evaluation time, UTC, millisecond precision.

component_id.description: Stable identifier of the banking-system component. Proposed vocabulary; the stable component identity is an open joint decision.

category.description: The blueprint's four candidate telemetry data categories.

quality.description: ok: finite and plausible. out_of_bounds: finite but outside the signal's plausible range (value kept). missing: no series. non_finite: NaN/Inf/unparseable. ambiguous: more series than the signal definition allows. Values are never invented for missing, non_finite or ambiguous observations.

dimensions.description: Label breakdown for grouped signals, e.g. {"aort_category": "savings"}. Empty object for ungrouped signals.
